result.title: EchoKV: Self-Corrective KV Cache Eviction via Iterative Query Feedback
result.summary: KV cache eviction is not merely a token-ranking problem: the workspace retained for generating eviction queries also determines the quality of those queries. Consequently, an early workspace error can distort later query observations and reinforce an incorrect final eviction decision, particularly when evidence is dispersed across a long context. We present EchoKV, which discovers and addresses this failure mode with iterative correction. It initializes a feedback-compatible bootstrap workspace using proposals at future decode positions, then uses early decode-generated queries to recover the workspace before the remaining lookahead steps. It uses the same number of workspace forward passes as LAQ while adding a tensor re-scoring operation for workspace repair. On LongBench (16 tasks, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), EchoKV shows notable improvements over LAQ on several tasks requiring dispersed evidence, including multi-hop cross-document QA and long single-document comprehension. Across budgets and backbones, EchoKV selectively improves evidence-intensive tasks while maintaining comparable performance on the remaining LongBench subsets. These results identify query--workspace coupling as a practical failure mode of query-driven KV eviction.

AI.brief_summary: EchoKV 指出 KV cache 驱逐中「工作区」与驱逐查询相互耦合，早期工作区误差会导致后续查询与驱逐决策被扭曲；它用未来位置提议初始化工作区，并借早期解码查询做迭代修正。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「保留的状态影响后续查询、进而影响证据选择」的闭环失败模式，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与状态更新耦合、误差自增强的问题同构，可供核查；但对象是 KV 驱逐而非 latent 推理状态。
